name: Ciriaco Bardales — an earlier partner, Carmen Morales, and an infant son who died in 1905
researcher_question: Before his marriage to Clara Amelia Palacios Oliva, did Ciriaco Bardales have a son by a Carmen Morales — an infant Ciriaco who died 12 August 1905 in Guatemala City?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-2.csv row 14, hint-samples.csv row 422, flags adds_spouse/adds_son, confidence 3). ADJUDICATED: true match at PROBABLE confidence; mandatory second opinion still outstanding. The father is identified by the register's origin field, which split 2-2 — the 1896 birth (ark:/61903/1:1:6K2Q-S4B2) and death (ark:/61903/1:1:Z95C-JY6Z) of an earlier son say the couple were capital-born, while the 1905 birth (ark:/61903/1:1:6KNJ-27P8) and death (ark:/61903/1:1:6D38-BQ8L) say Chiquimula. Broken by a third generation: the couple's surviving son José Luis (b. 1903) married in Chiquimula in 1924 (ark:/61903/1:1:XSGQ-CNSC), matching the tree person's Chiquimula birth and his own 1933 death entry (ark:/61903/1:1:Z9YP-SKN2, "originario de Esquipulas"). The tree person's marriage record (ark:/61903/1:1:X92L-7PCF) names him Ciriaco Leonides Bardales, son of Josefa Bardales, soltero, m. Clara Oliva 10 Dec 1907. The 1896 entries are explained as clerical habit, not refuted. See README "The origin question".
